user_story: As a guest, I want the system to reject a booking where check-out is before check-in so that invalid date ranges are prevented.

positive.title: Successfully create a valid booking
steps: Navigate to the booking system as a guest.
Select check-in date as today’s date.
Select check-out date as a date after the selected check-in date.

negative.title: Attempt to create a booking with check-out date before check-in date
steps: Navigate to the booking system as a guest.
Select check-in date as today’s date.
Select check-out date as a date before the selected check-in date.
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the check-out date cannot be before the check-in date and prevents the booking.

edge.title: Attempt to create a booking with check-in and check-out dates on the same day
steps: Navigate to the booking system as a guest.
Select check-in date as today's date.
Select check-out date as the same day as the check-in date.
edge.expected_result: The system either allows the booking as a single-day booking or displays a relevant error message if single-day bookings are not allowed.
